WELCOME TO THE REAL ESTATE SEARCH PAGE!
To view a property (or a group of properties) choose the Search tab above, and then select the type of search you would like to perform. You can also search from within the Map tab.
Once you are in a property record you will find tabs on the left side of the screen which will give you options for various types of information, including a Levy Distribution feature which shows how your tax dollars are allocated.
Please feel free to call our office at (937) 498-7202 with any questions you may have. My email address is aberning@shelbycountyauditors.com .
